Overview & City Profile

Teufen (AR) (Teufen (AR) (BFS 3024)) is a municipality in Bezirk Mittelland, Appenzell Ausserrhoden (coordinates 47.3936°N, 9.3886°E; population 6,362). Visitors use Teufen (AR) as a base to explore Appenzell Ausserrhoden's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Cheese fondue, Raclette, Rösti.

Within Appenzell Ausserrhoden Region (Bezirk Mittelland region), Teufen (AR) (Teufen (AR) (BFS 3024)) serves as a municipality (gemeinde / commune) in appenzell ausserrhoden region. Travelers exploring Appenzell Ausserrhoden often combine a stop in Teufen (AR) with regional highlights such as Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

Getting to Teufen (AR) & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Herisau Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)): Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Appenzell Ausserrhoden Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Herisau with Teufen (AR). Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep CHF 1,000 bills and CHF 100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Appenzell Ausserrhoden have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Teufen (AR) en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Teufen (AR) are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways station or airport in Appenzell Ausserrhoden can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Practical Travel Tips for Teufen (AR)

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Teufen (AR) (or at Herisau Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Teufen (AR) accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Switzerland Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Teufen (AR) (Teufen (AR) (BFS 3024)) located in Switzerland?

Teufen (AR) (Teufen (AR) (BFS 3024)) is a municipality (gemeinde / commune) located in Appenzell Ausserrhoden Region in the Bezirk Mittelland region of Switzerland (coordinates: 47.3936°N, 9.3886°E). It has a population of approximately 6,362 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Teufen (AR) by train?

Most visitors reach Teufen (AR) via the main prefectural gateway of Herisau Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways). Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Teufen (AR). You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare Calculator.

What local food is Teufen (AR) and Appenzell Ausserrhoden known for?

In Teufen (AR) and across Appenzell Ausserrhoden Region, top local dishes include Cheese fondue, Raclette, Rösti, as well as Bircher muesli and Swiss artisanal chocolate. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.
